title: Python for Everybody Specialization
description: Learn to Program and Analyze Data with Python. Covers basic programming concepts including data structures, networked application program interfaces, and databases.

title: Fluent Python: Clear, Concise, and Effective Programming
description: Deep dive into Python language features, OOP, dunder methods, generators, coroutines, and type hinting.

title: Complete SQL Bootcamp: Go from Zero to Hero
description: Master SQL query syntax, JOINs, GROUP BY, aggregations, subqueries, and window functions using PostgreSQL.

title: Data Analysis with Python & Pandas
description: Hands-on data analysis using Pandas, NumPy, data cleaning, filtering, and indexing techniques.

title: Storytelling with Data & Matplotlib
description: Create publication-quality charts and interactive plots with Matplotlib and Seaborn.

title: FastAPI Full Course - Building Modern Python APIs
description: Official interactive tutorial covering path parameters, request bodies, Pydantic schemas, dependency injection, and OAuth2 security.

title: Machine Learning Specialization by Andrew Ng
description: Comprehensive foundation in supervised learning, regression, classification, decision trees, and unsupervised learning with scikit-learn.

title: Deep Learning with PyTorch
description: Build and train neural networks, CNNs, and sequence models using PyTorch tensors and autograd.

title: Building Applications with LLMs & RAG
description: Learn vector embeddings, document chunking, retriever evaluation, and building RAG pipelines with LangChain/LlamaIndex.
